t: Sika waterproof coating 5kg is a reliable cement-based solution designed for preventing water and damp penetration in various building structures. The grey coating is suitable for both interior and exterior applications, offering robust protection for walls and floors. It is particularly effective for trade professionals working on basements and cellars, or as an external coating for concrete, brick, block, and bonded renders. The formulation ensures a durable barrier against moisture, maintaining structural integrity and preventing costly damp issues.
b: For Use in Basements/Cellars and as an External Coating for Concrete, Brick, Block & Bonded Renders
